hints.title: Small Constraint Brute Force
hints.text: With n <= 1000, we can check all possible substrings by fixing the start index and expanding the end index.

hints.title: Vowel and Consonant Tracking
hints.text: Maintain running counts of vowels and consonants as the right index expands.

hints.title: Divisibility Test
hints.text: If vowels equal consonants and (vowels * consonants) % k == 0, increment the beautiful substring count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Double loop scanning all substrings with running vowel and consonant counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^3) full substring slicing is unnecessary when counts update in O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that O(n^2) runs well within 1000 length limit.
